::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 3d 1864  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British LibraryAdd MSS 54920: 28-29
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),

There is one more copy of [the Trial](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd) that I should like to have sent to the Press - i.e., to [Events of the Month](organizations/other_69.qmd), Mozley’s, 6 Paternoster Row - it is a sort of school room [Athenaeum](organizations/other_170.qmd) which I wish to help forward

Thanks for your note. I hope nothing will prevent my meeting [Mrs D Macmillan](people/person_941.qmd) and I shall be glad to talk over your scheme, and see if it comes within my views and capabilities. The [Golden Deeds](cmy_books/cmybook_51.qmd) have been most enjoyable work

Yours faithfully
C.M. Yonge
